name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv as instructed. Created example.py with the documented API call using voice_id "JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb" and model "eleven_v3". The script ran successfully and generated a valid 41KB MP3 audio file (MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, mono) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion."
deviations: The quickstart uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox has no audio output capability, I saved the audio stream to a file (`output.mp3`) instead. This is the only deviation — the core API authentication, SDK usage, and text-to-speech generation followed the quickstart exactly.
